products.name: APC Smart-UPS On-Line SRT 3000VA 2U (SRT3000RMXLA)
products.summary: 3 kVA / 2700 W double-conversion online rack/tower UPS, 2U, 120 V, expandable runtime.
products.description: The APC Smart-UPS On-Line SRT3000RMXLA is a 2U rack/tower convertible double-conversion UPS rated 3000 VA / 2700 W at 120 V with pure sine wave output and zero transfer time. It provides eight NEMA 5-20R and one L5-30R outlets and supports up to 10 external battery packs.

products.name: APC Smart-UPS Ultra On-Line 5kVA Lithium-ion (SRTL5KRM2UT)
products.summary: 5 kVA / 4.9 kW lithium-ion double-conversion online UPS in 2U, 208 V, with network management card.
products.description: The APC Smart-UPS Ultra SRTL5KRM2UT is a 2U rack/tower lithium-ion double-conversion online UPS rated 5000 VA / 4.9 kW at 208 V. It has two L6-20R and two L6-30R outlets, is expandable to 10 external battery packs, is ENERGY STAR certified and includes a 1-year Secure Network Management Card subscription.
